item.title: [SwiftHFR] LOT-166 PR 2: arrival sleigh, crossing objects and piled snow (Noël soft)
item.body:
Replaces #840 (same commits on top of #849's rewritten history; agent force-pushes are blocked by the framework's guard-git hook). Reviews of #840 apply: Fable round 1 REQUEST CHANGES on b71d00a3, round 2 APPROVE on 909c6173, round 3 APPROVE on 9c5832ec (this head); verdicts and replies reposted below.

Stacks on #849 (PR 1 of LOT-166, replacing #834): until #849 merges, this diff includes it; `origin/dev-swift` is then merged in a separate merge commit and this description says so.

LOT-166
Refs #256 (PR 2 of 4 of the minimal slice: items 4 and 5, plus what PR 1 moved here: piled snow, the snow band clear of large titles, the pause while scrolling, the Instruments protocol). Left: elves (PR 3), Noël abusé after LOT-188 (PR 4); the Instruments figures, measured on a device by the operator (protocol below).
Claim: mac/M1

### Merge with #849 (2026-11-12)
- Merged #849 twice (70fe293d: dev-swift with LOT-188; d35a1124: decision (a) and the stored `theme_id`), no conflict; both remerge diffs are empty.
- Crossings, piled snow and the scroll pause are unchanged; over a gallery theme they draw as over Legacy, and only the accent differs (decision (a)).
- Local on d35a1124: iPhone 18 Pro 1442/1443 (known flake #564, green alone 15/15); iPad Pro 11 (M5) 1443/1443.

## Problem
After PR 1 the arrival is the « Oh Oh Oh ! » alert alone and Noël soft is a red accent with falling snow. THEMES.md §4–§5 and the issue ask for Santa's sleigh pulled by its reindeer before the alert, Christmas objects crossing the screen every 20–90 min of foreground time, and snow piled on cards and the bottom edge; PR 1 also left flakes crossing large titles and falling while a list scrolls.

## Cause
None of it existed: no crossing scheduler, no art in the app, no piled snow (PR 1's first drift crossed row text), a fixed 56 pt top band, no scroll signal.

## Change
- **Crossing scheduler** (`NoelCrossingModel`, `@Observable @MainActor`, injected clock, random source and `HapticFeedback`): counts foreground time only (`foregroundChanged(active:)` from the scene phase), draws the gap uniformly in 20–90 min at launch and at each crossing, so two crossings are never less than 20 min of foreground time apart; hands one crossing at a time to one scene, only on a clear screen (lock, sheet / composer / alert, keyboard: the PR 1 `ScreenState`), with animations allowed and Noël soft on; stops it as soon as one of them comes up or the app leaves the foreground; one light haptic per crossing through `HapticFeedback` (the haptics setting applies; never without animations, so never with Reduce Motion).
- **Paths** (`CrossingPath`, pure): enter by a random edge fully outside, leave by the opposite one fully outside, at a random tilt (≤ 30°, ≤ 15° for the sleigh) and direction, ≤ 3 s. Art with a front (the sleigh) is mirrored as a whole when it goes right to left and turned along its line (`facing` = the travel direction); a star, gift, ornament or flake stays upright.
- **Arrival sleigh**: the arrival queues it when animations are allowed; the alert waits until it has crossed (`alert(for:screen:)`); a quarter of the window height, at most 240 pt, 3 s, one haptic; a tap closes it (THEMES.md §4 rule 3); without animations it is dropped and the alert comes alone. Small objects: 64 pt, 2.2–3 s, the small sleigh, a star, three gifts, an ornament, a flake.
- **Layer** (`NoelCrossingLayer`, one per scene, in `NoelBand`, clipped to it): asks the model every 15 s (every 0.5 s while the sleigh waits), never per frame; a `TimelineView` runs only while an object crosses. Decorations take no touch (except the sleigh's tap-to-close) and are `accessibilityHidden`.
- **Band** (`NoelBand`): 104 pt at the top (the navigation bar with its large title), 64 pt at the bottom; falling snow and crossings stay inside, so no large title, button, badge, tab bar, status bar or home indicator is crossed.
- **Piled snow** (static, kept with Reduce Motion): two caps on the top edge of the Catégories card, drawn as its section header (a list cell clips what leaves it), so the card covers their base and they never reach a row's text; two drifts in the bottom safe area, in the corners either side of a 160 pt clearance for the home indicator (none without a bottom safe area).
- **Pause while scrolling** (`SeasonalScrollActivity`): `onScrollPhaseChange` on the Catégories, topic and MP lists; the reader's web view reports its pan gesture and deceleration (its delegate is left to WebKit). The snow's timeline pauses while any of them moves.
- **Art**: the operator's validated renders only (`docs/assets/themes/renders/`, 2026-11-10): `noel_sleigh` (checked: two reindeer harnessed in front, drawn facing right), `noel_star`, `noel_gift`, `noel_gift_blue`, `noel_gift_gold`, `noel_ornament`, `noel_snowflake`, `noel_snowpile`; trimmed and scaled into `Assets.xcassets/Noel/` (transparent PNG, 372 KB in all, largest 807×285) by the committed `tooling/art/noel-crossings/derive.swift` (no pixel drawn). Credit: CREDITS.md « Seasonal art ».
- Spec `docs/lots/LOT-166-seasonal-noel.md` updated (behaviour, edge cases, art, what is left).

Why this wide: items 4 and 5 of the slice and the three points PR 1 moved here; nothing of PRs 3–4.

## Tests
Swift Testing, injected clock (`SeasonTestClock`) and random source (`ScriptedRandom`, `SeededRandom`), haptics recorded through `HapticFeedback(store:perform:)`; no waiting.
- `CrossingPathTests` (300 seeded paths): every path enters by one edge and leaves by the opposite one fully outside, across-axis inside the area, all four edges used; the tilt is bounded and spread; ≤ 3 s even when asked for 9 s; directional art faces its travel both ways (mirrored iff it goes right to left, never upside down); upright art is neither mirrored nor turned; points clamp; nothing for an empty area.
- `NoelCrossingModelTests`: the gap is drawn in 20–90 min; nothing before 20 min of foreground time; only foreground time counts (hours in the background count for nothing, across returns); the next crossing waits 20 min again; nothing over the lock, a sheet / alert or the keyboard, and one that comes up stops a crossing; one light haptic per crossing, none with the haptics setting off; nothing (and no haptic) without animations; nothing outside Noël soft or in the background; one scene at a time; leaving the foreground stops a crossing.
- `NoelSleighArrivalTests`: on 01/12, 24/12, 25/12 and 26/12 the sleigh crosses before the alert (sides only, ≤ 3 s, one haptic); a quarter of the window, at most 240 pt (402, 874, 1366 pt windows); without animations the alert comes alone with no haptic; animations turned off before it plays drop it; a tap closes it and the alert follows; it waits for a clear screen; an empty (not yet laid out) area keeps it due; no sleigh on a later launch of the season.
- `NoelDecorationTests`: caps stay above the first row's text; drifts stay in the bottom safe area and off the home indicator, none without one; the snow pauses when inactive, in Low Power Mode and while scrolling; scrolling lasts until every scroll view stops; repeated reports write nothing (a drag reports every frame, and a write would redraw the snow's observers per frame); every item has its transparent image at the declared aspect ratio; only the sleigh has a front.
- PR 1's `SeasonalArrivalTests` now play the sleigh before asking for the alert (`playArrivalSleigh()`).

Shown red: two mutation runs of the new code (`mutation1.diff`, `mutation2.diff` in the author's work folder): run 1 (paths without random edge, tilt, clamp or facing; gap from 0, background time counted, no screen / animations / Noël soft / scene check, haptic bypassing `HapticFeedback`, no 240 pt cap, alert not waiting, caps entering the text, drifts over the indicator, no scroll pause, wrong art ratio, a star with a front) failed 26 of the 35 tests run; run 2 (tap-to-close a no-op, haptics ignoring the setting, a sleigh at every launch, no empty-area guard, upright art turned) failed the 5 tests that run 1 left green (`aTapClosesTheSleighAndTheAlertFollows`, `noHapticWithTheHapticsSettingOff`, `noSleighOnALaterLaunchOfTheSeason`, `nothingForAnEmptyArea`, `uprightArtIsNeitherMirroredNorTurned`). `anEmptyAreaKeepsTheSleighDue` (a bug found on the simulator: a layer asking before its first layout lost the sleigh) failed against the code before its fix; so did `repeatedReportsWriteNothing` (found in self-review: the reader's pan reports every frame).

Head 9c5832ec (after review rounds 1–3), counts from the xcresult bundles: iPhone 18 Pro 1422/1422; iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) 1420/1422, the failures being the known flake #564 and `VideoPlayerSheetTests.aPlayerThatAnswers401ReportsItAndAHealthyOneDoesNot` (WebKit), both green alone. Earlier local runs (`CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`, iOS 27.0 simulators, on the tree of 4c47e1b8, counts from the xcresult bundles): `xcodebuild build test` iPhone 18 Pro 1419/1419; iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) 1418/1419, the failure being the known flake #839 (`ReaderSettingsWatchTests.aStartedWatchReadsNowThenFollowsEveryChangeUntilStopped`), green alone (2/2). b71d00a3 (SwiftLint only: parameter structs, longer names; no behaviour change): the seasonal, crossing, decoration and haptics suites, iPhone 18 Pro 73/73.

Not unit-tested: `accessibilityHidden` on the decorations. A hosted-window probe of the accessibility tree saw no element at all in an app-hosted test (not even a plain image), so it could not fail; the modifiers are in `NoelCrossingLayer`, `SeasonalDecorations` (`NoelSnowLayer`), `NoelSnowPile` (caps, drifts). To check with the Accessibility Inspector on a device.

## Media
Simulator (iPhone 18 Pro, iOS 27.0), in-memory content in a demo window (Catégories-like list, four tabs), light and dark, in the author's work folder `~/agent-work/2026-11-12-ezzz-hfrnow-lot166-pr2/media/`: `light-sleigh.mp4`, `dark-sleigh.mp4` (the arrival sleigh, one each way: reindeer in front, mirrored as a whole), `light-alert.png`, `dark-alert.png` (the alert after it), `light-object.mp4` (an ornament crossing top to bottom), `dark-object.mp4` (the small sleigh, right to left), `light-noel-soft.png`, `dark-noel-soft.png`, `snow-caps-light-dark.png` (the caps on the card), frames in `frames/`. Not attachable from the CLI: the operator can drop them here.

## Instruments protocol (operator, on a device)
Release build signed by the operator; device date inside 01/12–24/12 (or Noël soft picked in Réglages › Thème inside the window); « Animations de saison » on; Low Power Mode and Reduce Motion off.
1. **Idle CPU with snow** (target ≤ 3 %): Time Profiler with CPU Usage, the app on Catégories, no touch for 60 s; the app's average CPU over the last 30 s, with Noël soft on, then off (baseline).
2. **Scrolling** (target: no hitch): Animation Hitches, fast flings for 20 s on Catégories, then on a long topic list, then in a topic, Noël soft on, then off; hitch-time ratio (ms/s) and hitch count for each.
3. **A crossing** (after ≥ 20 min in the foreground): CPU during the ≤ 3 s crossing and back to the idle figure after.
Post the figures with the device model and iOS version on this PR.

## Open points for the operator
1. The tokens' `gift-parachute` and `snowman-sled` have no render: plain gifts cross, and no snowman. New art would need the Blender licence question answered (`tooling/illustrations/README.md`).
2. Crossing objects without a front (star, gifts, ornament, flake) stay upright: « face the direction of travel » is read as applying to art that has a front (the sleigh).
3. The board shows drifts along the whole bottom edge; THEMES.md §4 rule 9 keeps the home indicator clear, so the drifts sit in the two corners.
4. One band for the whole window: on an iPad split view an inline-title column has about 50 pt without snow under its bar.
5. **gitleaks**: resolved by #849's rewrite (the season keys in `SettingKeyTests` are built from parts); no allowlist.
6. The sleigh render is 807 px wide and drawn up to about 570 pt: a little soft at 3×.

### Ledger

```gap-edit
GAP-147
SwiftHFR final: Noël (Noël soft, Noël abusé) selectable 01/12–26/12 on local dates every year, Noël soft switched on 01/12–24/12 unless opted out, arrival: Santa's sleigh pulled by its reindeer crosses the screen, then the « Oh Oh Oh ! » alert; elves packing and restore of the previous theme (silent after 02/01); Noël soft = legacy's red accent over the Legacy theme, a gallery theme keeping its own accent (operator, 2026-11-12), never stored,, procedural light snow (legacy's snow frames have no stated licence), snow piled on the first card and in the bottom corners, and a Christmas object crossing the screen every 20–90 min of foreground time; Samain 01/10–31/10 (LOT-191); 14 July overlay (LOT-194); « Thèmes de saison automatiques » and « Animations de saison » settings (docs/THEMES.md §4–§5).
```

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

comments.body:
_Reposted from #840 (same commits)._

REQUEST CHANGES — **Adversarial review (Fable 5.1), round 1** — head b71d00a3 (PR #840, reviewed on top of #834 @ 00a28dd7)

1. **High** — `App/SwiftHFR/Settings/Seasons/NoelCrossingLayer.swift:272,300`. The watch task is keyed on `isWatching = activeTheme == .noelSoft || crossings.arrivalPending`. When the arrival sleigh starts, `crossing()` sets `arrivalPending = false` (`NoelCrossingModel.swift:450`); if Noël soft is not on (first launch 25–26/12, decision Q2; « Thèmes de saison automatiques » off), `isWatching` flips to false, `.task(id:)` cancels the running `watch`, whose exit path calls `crossings.finish(crossing.id)` (`:320`): the sleigh is removed after one frame and the « Oh Oh Oh ! » alert comes at once. The arrival-only phase ships without its sleigh; `NoelSleighArrivalTests.theSleighCrossesBeforeTheAlert(25/26)` cannot see it (model only). Fix: keep watching while this scene's crossing plays (`|| crossings.current?.scene == scene`), extract the predicate into the model (e.g. `shouldWatch(scene:theme:)`) and test that it stays true after the sleigh starts on 25/12 with no theme on.
2. **Low** — `SeasonalScrollActivity.swift:787-790`. `settle()` assumes `isDecelerating` is already true when the watcher's `.ended` target runs; if UIKit's own pan handler runs after it, the loop exits at once and the snow resumes during the reader's fling. Check on device or wait one tick before the first check.
3. **Detail** — `NoelSnowPile.swift:511`. `rowTextPadding = 8` holds for the Catégories rows (default insets) only; `ListDensity.compact` rows have 3 pt top insets, equal to `capOverlap`. Note the constraint next to `capOverlap` so a later density change on that list keeps the cap off the text.

Ledger (`gap-edit` GAP-147): format valid (`ledger.py check-body`: 1 block ok), text matches what the PR ships.

**Verified**: diff `00a28dd7...b71d00a3` read in full in a throwaway worktree (removed); issue #256, THEMES.md §4–§6, LOT-166 spec, both LESSONS tables. `swift tooling/art/noel-crossings/derive.swift` run on the worktree: the eight committed PNGs are reproduced byte-for-byte from `docs/assets/themes/renders/` (trim + scale only); sleigh render faces its travel, reindeer in front. Line lengths ≤ 140 on every changed Swift file. `CrossingPath.random` bounds checked by hand (both ends fully outside, across-axis within `[margin, across − margin]`, `duration ≤ 3`); facing/mirror algebra checked; App-level `scenePhase` is the aggregate, so two iPad windows do not stop the foreground clock. No xcodebuild run (per brief); SwiftLint not installed locally.


---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

_Reposted from #840 (same commits)._

APPROVE — **Adversarial review (Fable 5.1), round 2** — head 909c6173 (PR #840, on top of #834 @ 0d1cc32d)

Round-1 findings:
- **F1 (High) fixed.** `NoelCrossingModel.shouldWatch(scene:theme:)` (`NoelCrossingModel.swift:185`) keeps `isWatching` true while `current?.scene == scene`, so starting the sleigh (which clears `arrivalPending`) no longer changes the `.task(id:)` key on 25–26/12 or with automatic themes off. Walked every exit: end of path, tap, `screenChanged` (keyboard/sheet/lock), `foregroundChanged(false)`, `release` all set `current = nil` → `shouldWatch` false → the task is cancelled, the sleep throws, the loop exits; nothing keeps polling, no leak. iPad: the scene that got the sleigh keeps watching, the other stops (`current.scene != scene`, `arrivalPending` false) unless Noël soft is on (15 s poll, by design). `NoelSleighArrivalTests.aSceneKeepsWatchingWhileItsSleighCrossesWithNoThemeOn` fails on its line 105 with the round-1 predicate (`theme == .noelSoft || arrivalPending`): it discriminates the fix at model level; the layer's wiring is a one-liner read by eye (no xcodebuild, per brief).
- **F2 (Low) fixed.** `SeasonalScrollActivity.swift:323-326`: the first `isDecelerating` read now comes after one 100 ms tick; a touch-down during the fling (`isTracking`) leaves the flag to the new pan's `.began`.
- **F3 (Detail) fixed.** `NoelSnowPile.swift:9-14` states the compact-density constraint.

New finding (pre-existing in round 1, missed then; not introduced by the fix):

1. **Low** — `NoelCrossingLayer.swift:33-36, 77-81`. The watch task is keyed on `area`; a rotation, an iPad split-view or Stage Manager resize (THEMES.md line 101 lists them) during the 3 s arrival sleigh restarts the task, whose cancelled exit path calls `finish(crossing.id)`: the sleigh vanishes mid-screen and, `arrivalPending` being already false, the once-a-year arrival ships without it (the alert follows at once). Fix: when the task is cancelled with the crossing still current and `isArrival`, re-queue it (`arrivalPending = true`, through a model method such as `interrupt(id)`) instead of finishing it, and test that an interrupted arrival stays due.

Range-diff `00a28dd7..b71d00a3` vs `0d1cc32d..909c6173~1`: the four commits are byte-identical (`=`), nothing but the rebase.
Ledger (`gap-edit` GAP-147): `ledger.py check-body --labels ledger` → 1 block ok; text unchanged from round 1 and matching what ships.

**Verified**: throwaway worktree at 909c6173 (removed); `git show 909c6173` read in full; full diff `0d1cc32d...909c6173` re-read on the Seasons files, the three list views, `ReaderWebController`, `SwiftHFRApp` (`scenePhase` is read on the `App` struct: aggregate, so two iPad windows do not stop the foreground clock), the tests and the LOT-166 spec; issue #256, THEMES.md, both LESSONS tables. Line lengths ≤ 140 on every changed Swift file. No xcodebuild (per brief); the GitHub PR still points at b71d00a3 with base `dev-swift`: 909c6173 is not pushed yet, and the PR will carry #834's commits until #834 lands.


---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

_Reposted from #840 (same commits)._

APPROVE — **Adversarial review (Fable 5.1), round 3** — head 9c5832ec (PR #840, one commit on 909c6173, on top of #834 @ 0d1cc32d)

Round-2 Low fixed for a one-shot resize. `NoelCrossingLayer.swift:81-86` calls `interrupt` only on `Task.isCancelled`; `NoelCrossingModel.interrupt` (`:135-142`) re-queues the arrival at most `maxArrivalReplays` times, an ordinary object just ends. Walked the paths that clear `current` before the cancel (tap → `finish`, `screenChanged`, `release` in `onDisappear`, `foregroundChanged(false)`): all leave `current == nil`, so `interrupt` is a no-op and nothing is replayed, as the spec wants. Both orders of the cancelled task's resume and the new task's first ask converge (the new task either re-queues through `interrupt` or picks the old crossing, which `interrupt` then clears). iPad two scenes: a re-queued arrival is taken by the first scene with a clear screen; the single `current` keeps the other one out. The cap makes a loop impossible and the alert is never lost: once `arrivalReplays == 2`, `arrivalPending` stays false and `alert(for:screen:)` fires; `queueArrival` resets the counter once per season (`arrive` is guarded by `noelArrivalShown`). A kill during the sleigh keeps the stored `noelArrivalPending`: next launch, the alert alone (pre-existing, acceptable).

Tests discriminate: `anInterruptedArrivalStaysDueAndStillPlaysBeforeTheAlert` fails if `interrupt` behaves like `finish` (`arrivalPending` false), if the cap is 1 (`third` is nil) or absent (the fourth `sleigh` is not nil); `anInterruptedObjectIsNotReplayed` fails if any item is re-queued.

1. **Low** — `NoelCrossingModel.swift:82, 135-142`; spec line `LOT-166-seasonal-noel.md:52`. The cap counts size changes, not gestures: a split-view divider drag or a Stage Manager resize is a live resize (many `proxy.size` values per second), and SwiftUI's animated layout can also hand a `GeometryReader` several sizes during one rotation. Scenario: the arrival sleigh is crossing, the user drags the divider → `.task(id:)` restarts on each size → `interrupt` twice, two new `start`s (two more light haptics, two gap resets), the third cut drops the arrival and the alert comes mid-drag; the sentence "plays again … at most twice" does not hold for those gestures. Fix: cap by time instead of count (re-queue while less than ~10–15 s of foreground time have passed since the first sleigh start) or restart the watch only on a settled area (a short debounce before the ask); either way, one Mac check of a rotation and a divider drag during the sleigh, counting `interrupt` calls.
2. **Detail** — `NoelCrossingLayer.swift:81`. The comment says the arrival is queued again when "the scene went away", but `onDisappear` runs `release(scene:)` synchronously before the cancelled sleep resumes, so `interrupt` finds `current == nil` and the arrival is dropped (the spec's "a scene that goes away stops its crossing"). Name only the resize in the comment.

**Verified**: throwaway worktree at 9c5832ec (removed); `git show 9c5832ec` read in full; `NoelCrossingLayer.swift`, `NoelCrossingModel.swift`, `SeasonalThemeModel.swift` (`arrive`, `alert`, `refresh`), `SeasonalDecorations.swift` (the layer sits on the app root, so a navigation push never releases it), `SwiftHFRApp.swift` (`scenePhase` wiring), both test files and their helpers, the LOT-166 spec, THEMES.md (§4 rules, line 101), both LESSONS tables. Line lengths ≤ 140 on the four changed Swift files. No xcodebuild, no SwiftLint locally (CI), per brief; the head is not pushed, the PR still shows 909c6173's predecessor.


---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Author's replies to the Fable findings (rounds 1 and 2)**

**Round 1, F1 (High): the sleigh was cut when Noël soft is off.** Fixed in 909c6173. The watch predicate now lives in the model as `NoelCrossingModel.shouldWatch(scene:theme:)`. It is true when Noël soft is on, when the sleigh is due, or while this scene's own crossing plays (`current?.scene == scene`). `NoelCrossingLayer.isWatching` uses it, so on 25–26/12, or with automatic themes off, the task is no longer cancelled when the sleigh starts and `arrivalPending` drops. New test: `NoelSleighArrivalTests.aSceneKeepsWatchingWhileItsSleighCrossesWithNoThemeOn`, which failed against the old predicate.

**Round 1, F2 (Low): `settle()` ordering.** Fixed in 909c6173. `settle()` now waits one 100 ms tick before it first reads `isDecelerating`, so the result no longer depends on whether this target runs before or after the scroll view's own pan handler. The cost: after a drag with no fling, the snow stays paused at most 100 ms longer. A unit test cannot order UIKit's gesture targets, so this needs a device check, which fits into step 2 of the Instruments protocol.

**Round 1, F3 (Detail): `rowTextPadding` and compact density.** Noted in 909c6173. A comment at `SnowPileLayout.capOverlap` and the spec state the constraint. The caps are the section's header, and the card's cell covers their base.

**Round 2, Low: an arrival cut by a resize.** Fixed in 9c5832ec.
